title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Fixed the Dinosaur's Roar
moral: A good friend helps you when something goes wrong.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into the dinosaur valley. Big rocky cliffs stood all around. Dinosaurs stomped and played in the flat valley below. A little silver robot sat on a rock and watched them. {{NAME}} waved to the robot.
